description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Amentum is a global engineering and technology solutions company supporting defense, intelligence, energy, and civilian missions. The role supports the FAA Technical Center’s Center Operations Division through GIS application development, database management, software integration, geospatial data management, and facilities-management system support.
GIS application developer and database specialist building geospatial tools, integrating facilities data, and maintaining spatial databases

Responsibilities:
• Support GIS application development/integration in web and mobile applications focusing on ArcGIS, ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Online
• Software application development support: author, publish, maintain and update web services for web applications including but not limited to data development, data capture from satellite systems and tabular data integration into geospatial databases
• Develop facilities-related GIS application tools for use in GIS/GPS projects
• Must have experience with common desktop applications (i.e., MS Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.)
• Specialized experience includes relational database management systems (RDBMS) such as Microsoft SQL Server, Postgresql, Oracle database, or other RDBMSand Esri software (such as ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Desktop and/or ArcGIS Pro), or other relevant database software tools.f.     Computerized data entry and formatting, database management, and database utilization
• Maintain and update SQL server databases, support data integration into development and operational systems
• Perform geographic data digitizing, data development, data capture from satellite systems and tabular data integration into geospatial databases
• Create geospatial databases, tables, database structures, and establishes database relationships to tabular RDBMS
• Work with facilities management databases for integration into GIS database and applications
• Perform data acquisition, data reformatting, and application of GIS and image processing software in support of Tech Center projects, activities, and issues
• Operate the GIS, Archibus, Oracle, and all associated hardware and software to display the results of computer analysis by applying cartographic principles in the production of finished maps
• Update the Master Plan with aboveground and below ground utility locations; updates buildings from new construction, renovations and/or demolition, and other site work
• Provide hardware and software support for the GIS, Archibus and other facilities management programs, including training and assisting system users
• Conduct data file management, including editing, merging, deletion, and additions
• Interact with scientists and/or engineers regarding the procurement, preparation, and/or editing of related project data

Requirements:
• Must be a U.S. Citizen
• Must have graduated from an accredited college with a bachelor's degree in one of the following disciplines: computer science, information science, information technology and information systems, systems and network administration, software engineering, computer engineering

Skills:
